[SWS_DM_00155] Extended data record numeration
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04206, RS_Diag_04189
⌈
Extended data record numbers shall always be determined by the configuration.
The
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord.recordNumber
configuration parameter
defines the record number for each
extended data record
.
⌋
